name: Denmark
description: Denmark is a parliamentary constitutional monarchy in Northern Europe and a pioneer of wind energy. Its Nordic welfare model pairs flexible labor markets with broad social protection, while the economy specializes in pharmaceuticals, shipping, food and design. An EU member outside the eurozone, it anchors the Realm community with Greenland and the Faroe Islands.

works.title: Actor Set Evolution
works.description: Temporal mapping of Denmark's actor space from cooperative dairies and shipping lines through flexicurity labor-market institutions to wind-turbine manufacturers, Novo-group pharma, and Realm-wide governance.

works.title: Wind Energy and Pharma Network
works.description: Network analysis of turbine OEMs, offshore wind farms, insulin and enzyme pipelines, and cooperative ownership models exporting worldwide.

works.title: Realm and Municipal Structure
works.description: Geospatial representation of five regions and ninety-eight municipalities alongside Greenland-Faroe Realm ties, straits geography and island interconnectors.
